prompt: On a practice worksheet, a student reads this problem: A book stall receives 7 bundles with 5 bookmarks in each bundle. The owner adds 8 single bookmarks from a desk drawer to the same display. How many bookmarks are on the display after this addition?
author_note: Scripted lookup control variant. The identical nonnumeric prefix is added to the original and rewrite. Only 9->7 bundles, 4->5 per bundle, and 6->8 singles change. The requested total uses the same multiplication-plus-addition structure.
